description: SQS-triggered handler that processes LLM queries using LangChain adapters for Bedrock, SageMaker, and Bedrock Agents. Performs RAG retrieval, sends streaming responses via SNS
notes: Second most complex handler. Uses LangChain which wraps Bedrock calls indirectly. Has adapters for multiple model providers. CDK grants bedrock:* which is overpermissioned. Publishes to encrypted SNS topic. Reads from multiple RAG engines conditionally.
